content.title: Woodinville Planning Commission
content.summary: The Planning Commission in Woodinville is a volunteer body of seven residents appointed by the City Council to advise on land use, long-range planning, capital projects, and development agreements. The Commission meets monthly and also designates members to a Design Review Committee for building design recommendations.

steps.title: Appointment of Members
steps.text: Members are interviewed and appointed by the City Council to serve a four-year term.

steps.title: Attend Regular Meetings
steps.text: Regular Planning Commission meetings take place on the 4th Wednesday of every month at 7:00 pm at Woodinville City Hall.

steps.title: Access Meeting Materials
steps.text: Current and prior agendas, packets, minutes, and videos can be found in the City's Meetings and Agendas Portal.
